title: 7 Banks Offering $10,000 (Soft Pull – Check Before You Apply)
actionable_recommendations: Consider applying for a loan from Upstart, Avant, Upgrade, LendingClub, Universal, or Best Egg as they perform soft credit pulls.
If you have military affiliation, open an account with Navy Federal for potentially favorable loan terms.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Best Egg may offer loans for individuals with poor credit histories.
Navy Federal Credit Union is described as one of the most lenient lenders.
Navy Federal requires only $5 to open an account.
intended_organization_or_user: Individuals seeking unsecured loans without affecting their credit scores.
major_ideas: Many lenders allow soft credit pulls to assess loan eligibility without a hard inquiry.
Bank recommendations include Upstart, Avant, Upgrade, LendingClub, Universal, Best Egg, and Navy Federal.
prerequisites: Have military affiliation for Navy Federal account.
Understand your current credit score before applying.
proposed_workflow: Apply using a soft credit pull to understand eligibility.
If pre-approved, decide whether to proceed with a full application which includes a hard credit pull.
